title: Secondary damage
wikitext:
'''Secondary damage''' is a [[damage source]] that is not [[attack]] damage, [[spell]] damage, or [[damage over time]]. It [[hit]]s. 

==Mechanics==
Secondary damage is a hit that isn't spell or attack damage. It is most commonly dealt by [[explosion]]s and [[self-damage]]. 

Secondary damage ''to enemies'' is not affected by modifiers for attack or spell damage (even when part of a skill like {{il|Detonate Dead}}), but can otherwise be scaled normally. Damage can be [[damage effectiveness|added]]<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J24ZM7t5a4I</ref> (e.g. {{il|Crown of the Tyrant}}), [[conversion|converted]], and multiplied by damage modifiers, critical strikes, and [[double damage|double or triple damage]]. It can also inflict ailments and other on-hit effects. 

Secondary damage ''to yourself'' is unaffected by offensive modifiers, including properties such as {{psl|Shaper of Winter}}. Even when a self-hit becomes a [[critical strike]] (e.g. while cursed by {{il|Assassin's Mark}}), no extra damage will be dealt. 

Defensively, secondary damage is [[receiving damage|mitigated]] like other hits. When secondary damage originates from spells or attacks, it can be [[Block|blocked]], [[Dodge|dodged]], [[Spell suppression|suppressed]], or [[evasion|evaded]] like attack or spell damage.<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/q30pjj/comment/hfp0lfx/ A first overview and opinion of the Evasion/Dodge changes]</ref> (Self-damage from spells or attacks such as {{il|Forbidden Rite}} and {{il|Boneshatter}} cannot.) 

Secondary damage can be [[reflect]]ed, though [[explosion]]s cannot. {{il|Herald of Thunder}} is a rare form of secondary damage susceptible to damage reflection. 

==Skill gems==
<onlyinclude>The following skills have a secondary damage component:
{{Drop enabled gem table

    OR (
        skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%secondary_damage%"
        AND skill_stats_per_level.id NOT LIKE "%no_secondary_damage%"
        OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%corpse_explosion%"
OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%skill_minion_explosion%" )
|default=Currently, there are no [[active skill gem]]s that deal [[secondary damage]].

==Sources other than gems==
'''Explosions''': All [[explosion]]s deal secondary damage.

'''Self-damage''': Most non-DoT [[Hit#Self-damage|self-damage]] (e.g. {{il|Heartbound Loop}}, {{il|Forbidden Rite}}) is secondary damage. {{il|Hiltless}} deals reflected attack damage, however.
